_meta.description:
Phase 5.9 (s191, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.5 (s192, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.6 (s193, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.7 (s194, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.8 (s195, 2026-05-14) + Phase 5.9.9 (s196, 2026-05-14) — per-(champion, key) block_index_overrides for the ds.ability + ds.burst scorers. Default block_index=0 picks the first damage block of the canonical form, which matches the engine's pre-s191 `block_strategy="first"` behavior and is correct for ~95% of champions. A minority of champions have a later damage block that represents the realistic burst-window damage: the empowered/total/max variant that fires when canonical conditions are met (target poisoned, target chilled, full-charge windup, all bounces same target, sub-execute HP, full-channel duration, max sphere stacks, etc.). For ranking purposes (operator is comparing item builds for *their* champion in *their* combo), assuming amped conditions are met is the right model — same intuition as the engine already baking in `target_missing_hp_pct` and treating skillshots as landed. Keys are DDragon canonical ids; values map ability key (Q/W/E/R) OR repeat-variant token (Q2/W2/E2/R2 — Phase 5.9.5) to the 0-indexed block_index to use when the operator doesn't supply an explicit dict. Operator's per-call dict still wins per-key — registry fills any keys the caller didn't override.

Token-level lookup precedence (Phase 5.9.5): the burst combo walker checks the CANONICAL token first (e.g., "R2" for the Akali R recast), then falls back to the base ABILITY KEY (e.g., "R"). This lets a champion model its multi-step ability sequence with different block selections per token instance. `compute_ability_dps` is unaffected — it only iterates base spell keys (Q/W/E/R), so any R2-keyed entry is invisible to the mage scorer; token-variant entries only fire in the burst combo walker.

Phase 5.9.6 (s193): adds 8 new champion entries + extends Anivia (Q=2). Most are 'per-tick → total' wins for channeled abilities (Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, Velkoz R Disintegration Ray, AurelionSol E Singularity, MissFortune E Make It Rain, Samira R Inferno Trigger, Alistar E Trample, Singed Q Poison Trail) where the engine's default 'first damage block' picks the per-tick value but the real per-cast contribution is the full-channel total. Syndra R uses block 2 for max-sphere-stack realistic-burst case (typically 7+ Dark Spheres at level 11+).

Phase 5.9.7 (s194): closes the s193 calibration-follow-up list. Adds Corki W=1 (Valkyrie fire trail full-duration total) + Corki E=1 (Gatling Gun full-channel) + Hecarim W=1 (Spirit of Dread full-aura) + Hecarim E=1 (Devastating Charge max-charge) + Jayce Q=1 (Shock Blast Acceleration Gate increased damage, layered on s187's Jayce Q form_index=1 cannon-form override — orthogonal: form_index selects cannon form 1, block_index then selects the gate-amped block 1 within that form) + Jayce W=1 (Lightning Field hammer-aura full duration) + Rell R=1 (Magnet Storm full-channel total) + DrMundo W=1 (Heart Zapper full-channel drain total; block 2 recast detonation is a separate +25% one-time burst not summed in current schema — minor under-count, acceptable). All entries verified against Meraki ATTR names (per-tick → total or min → max amped variants); the channel/aura/charge family closes the systematic under-count for non-mage/non-assassin ability-based champions queried via /ability-dps + /burst direct routes.

Phase 5.9.9 (s196): pure-data continuation following s195's same four-pattern model — 17 new (champion, key) entries (14 new champions + 3 key extensions on Akali, Cassiopeia, Morgana). Same 'token-canonical first, base-key fallback' walker; zero code changes. Pattern A multi-hit single-target totals (12 entries): Akali E=2 (E1+E2 Shuriken Flip chain, ~3.33×), Akshan Q=1 (Avengerang ricochet out+return, 2×), Cassiopeia W=1 (Miasma full duration, 5×), Chogath E=1 (Vorpal Spikes 3-hit total, 3×), Draven R=1 (Whirling Death out+return, 2×), Lillia W=1 (Watch Out! Eep! center hit, 3×), Morgana R=1 (Soul Shackles tether full duration, 2×), Nautilus E=2 (Riptide 3-wave same target, 2×), Riven Q=1 (Broken Wings 3-cast total, 3×), Sett Q=1 (Knuckle Down 2-AA total, 2×), Skarner Q=1 (Shattered Earth empowered 3-hit, 3×), Soraka E=1 (Equinox 2-tick total, 2×). Pattern B fully-charged/condition-amp (5 entries): Gragas Q=1 (Barrel Roll max-fermented, 1.5×), Karthus Q=1 (Lay Waste single-target enhanced, 2×), Khazix Q=1 (Taste Their Fear isolation amp, 2.1×), KogMaw R=1 (Living Artillery low-HP execute, 2×), Pantheon Q=1 (Comet Spear fully-charged hurl, 2.2×). Math verified per-rank against Meraki snapshot for each entry (block N's base + scaling fields match the canonical-condition multiple of block 0's components). Nidalee Q skipped intentionally: would conflict with s187's form_index=1 cougar-form override (form selects cougar Takedown; block_index=1 would refer to a Takedown block, not the human Javelin max-distance). Pantheon W skipped: Shield Vault has no damage scaling. Pantheon R skipped: block 1 'Magic Damage' has no canonical amp.

Phase 5.9.8 (s195): pure-data continuation — 13 new (champion, key) entries spanning four established sub-patterns that each map cleanly to the s191 'operator commits to amped condition' model. (A) Multi-hit single-target totals (operator commits to focus all hits/bolts/missiles on one target): Ahri W=2 (Fox-Fire 3 bolts), Kaisa Q=2 (Icathian Rain missiles), Lulu Q=3 (Glitterlance both passes), Sivir Q=2 (Boomerang out + back), Talon W=2 (Rake out + return), Talon R=2 (Shadow Assault unstealth chain), Velkoz W=2 (Void Rift both halves), Ekko Q=3 (Timewinder out + return). (B) Fully-charged amps (operator commits to wind-up duration in burst window): Varus Q=1 (fully-charged Piercing Arrow, 1.5× block 0), Zoe Q=1 (long-distance Paddle Star post-E teleport, 2.5× block 0), Vladimir E=1 (2-charge Tides of Blood, 2× block 0 + 4× caster HP scaling). (C) Recast amps (operator commits to executing both stages in window): Camille Q=2 (Precision Protocol second cast, 2× block 0). (D) CC-conditional duration totals (operator commits to root + full duration): Morgana W=3 (Tormented Shadow full duration vs rooted = Maximum Total Damage). All 13 verified per-rank math against Meraki snapshot (block N's base + scaling fields match the sum of components from blocks 0..N-1 for the canonical-condition case). Same 'token-canonical first, base-key fallback' walker logic as s192 — zero code changes, just JSON expansion.
_meta.rationale:
Per-(champion, key) entries (verified against data/daemon_slayer/16.10.1/champion_abilities.json):
  Ahri Q block1 'Total Mixed Damage' = 2× block0 'Damage Per Pass' (orb both passes)
  Ahri W block2 'Total Single-Target Damage' = block 0 (initial flame) + 2× block 1 (subsequent flames vs same target) — base 64-192 = 40 + 12×2 (rank 5 = 120 + 36×2), ap_pct=64% = 40% + 12%×2; canonical Ahri burst commits all 3 Fox-Fire bolts to one target at close range
  Akali E block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (E1 Shuriken Flip throw, 21-105 + 33% AP + 30% tAD) + block 1 (E2 grappling-hook dash hit on tagged target, 49-245 + 77% AP + 70% tAD) — base 70-350 = 21 + 49 (rank 5 = 105 + 245); ap_pct=110% = 33% + 77%; canonical Akali E1-E2 dash-back combo on shurikened target = exact 3.33× block 0 (Phase 5.9.9)
  Akali R block0 'Magic Damage' = R1 base damage with 30% AP + 50% bonus AD (initial dash cast)
  Akali R2 block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = R2 max-execute scaling (210/420/630 + 90% AP vs low-HP target via missing-HP curve); R1 keeps block0 because it has its own bonus-AD scaling and the missing-HP amp only fires on the recast
  Akshan Q block1 'Total Physical Damage' = block 0 (Avengerang throw 5-85) + block 0 (return-pass hit on bouncing back to same target) — base 10-170 = exact 2× block 0; ap_pct 0% (no AP scaling on Akshan Q); canonical Akshan Q at near-max range hits the original target on both throw and return-bounce (Phase 5.9.9)
  Alistar E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Trample-channel total (per-tick × 10 ticks at rank 5: 20 × 10 = 200 base, 7% AP × 10 = 70% AP)
  Anivia Q block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (initial pass) + block 1 (detonation) — full Flash Frost commit
  Anivia E block1 'Enhanced Damage' = 2× block0 vs chilled target (Q stun applies chill)
  AurelionSol E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Singularity duration sum (per-tick × ~20 ticks at rank 5: 7.5 × 20 = 150 base)
  Aurora Q block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = full-charged Twofold Hex (1.5× of block0/1)
  Belveth E block2 'Maximum Physical Damage per hit' = full-channel Royal Maelstrom (4× block1 min)
  Brand W block1 'Increased Damage' = 1.25× block0 vs CC'd or Blaze-stacked target
  Brand R block1 'Total Single-Target Damage' = 3× block0 (all bounces back to same target)
  Camille Q block2 'Increased Mixed Damage' = 2nd cast Precision Protocol total_ad_pct=40-80% = 2× block 0 (20-40%); canonical Q-then-Q-recast within 4s burst window
  Cassiopeia E block1 'Total Enhanced Damage' = canonical Twin Fang amp vs poisoned (Q/W applies poison)
  Cassiopeia W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Miasma cloud duration (per-second 20-40 + 10% AP × 5 ticks = 100-200 + 50% AP); operator drops W to slow target, target walks through cloud taking full duration of damage (Phase 5.9.9)
  Chogath E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = 3 Vorpal Spikes hits all landing on same target — base 60-300 = exact 3× block 0 (20-100); Cho'gath E is a 3-hit empowered auto-attack rotation, canonical close-range commit hits all 3 spikes on one target (Phase 5.9.9)
  Corki W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Valkyrie fire-trail duration (per-tick 40-100 + 30% AP + 40% bAD × ~5 ticks = 200-500 + 150% AP + 200% bAD); block 0 is per-tick of the trail
  Corki E block1 'Total Physical Damage' = full Gatling Gun 4-second channel (per-tick 5-17.5 + 15% bAD × 16 shots = 80-280 + 240% bAD)
  Diana W block2 'Total Magic Damage' = 3× block1 per-orb (all 3 Pale Cascade orbs land)
  Draven R block1 'Total Physical Damage' = block 0 (Whirling Death out, 175-375) + block 0 (return-pass hit) — base 350-750 = exact 2× block 0; canonical Draven R commits to hitting the original target on both the outgoing axe and the boomerang return (Phase 5.9.9)
  DrMundo W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Heart Zapper 4-second drain channel (per-tick 5-20 × 16 ticks = 80-320 base, also 1% bonus HP per tick × 16 = 16% bonus HP total); block 2 'Magic Damage' is the recast detonation +25% one-time burst, not summed in current single-block_index schema (minor under-count, acceptable)
  Ekko Q block3 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (Timewinder throw) + block 2 (return-pass) — base 120-280 = 80 + 40 (rank 5 = 140 + 140); ap_pct=90% = 30% + 60%; canonical Ekko Q out-and-back commits both passes to same target
  Evelynn R block1 'Empowered Damage' = 2.4× block0 vs sub-30% HP target (Last Caress execute)
  Fiddlesticks R block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Crowstorm-channel total (per-tick × ~20 ticks at rank 3: 87.5 × 20 = 1750 base, 12.5% × 20 = 250% AP)
  Gragas Q block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = Barrel Roll fully-fermented after 4-second hold; block 1 base 120-360 vs block 0 80-240 ≈ 1.5×; ap_pct 100% vs 60% ≈ 1.67×; canonical Gragas Q poke holds for max charge then releases (Phase 5.9.9, pattern B fully-charged amp)
  Hecarim W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Spirit of Dread 4-second aura (per-tick 20-60 + 20% AP × 5 ticks = 100-300 + 100% AP)
  Hecarim E block1 'Maximum Physical Damage' = full-charge Devastating Charge after running 250 units (2× block 0 'Minimum Physical Damage'); operator commits to full charge in burst window — same modeling as Belveth E
  Jayce Q block1 'Increased Damage' = Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate (canonical Jayce combo — fires E gate first, then Q through it for 1.4× damage); layered on s187's Jayce Q form_index=1 cannon-form override (form_index resolves to cannon form 1; block_index=1 then selects the gate-amped block within that form)
  Jayce W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Lightning Field hammer-form 4-second aura (per-tick 35-95 + 25% AP × 4 ticks = 140-380 + 100% AP); form 0 = hammer is default — form 1 (cannon Hyper Charge) has no damage block
  Kaisa Q block2 'Total Single-Target Damage' = block 0 (first missile full) + N× block 1 (reduced subsequent) where the math sums to block 2 base=90-225 + bAD=123.75% + AP=45% (rank 5 = 1× full 100 + multiple 25 reduced shots focused on one target = 225); canonical Icathian Rain in burst against a single isolated target
  Karthus Q block1 'Enhanced Damage' = Lay Waste against a single target (no other enemies in radius) — base 80-232 vs block 0 40-116 = exact 2× block 0; canonical Karthus solo-target lane harass commits to Q hitting only one enemy (Karthus Q passive doubles damage when hitting only one champion) (Phase 5.9.9, pattern B condition amp)
  Khazix Q block1 'Increased Damage' = Taste Their Fear vs isolated target — base 168-378 vs block 0 80-180 = exact 2.1× block 0; canonical Kha'Zix burst commits to attacking an isolated target (no allied minions/champions nearby) which is Kha'Zix's defining mechanic (Phase 5.9.9, pattern B condition amp)
  KogMaw R block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = Living Artillery vs low-HP target — base 200-360 vs block 0 100-180 = exact 2× block 0; Kog'Maw R has a max-damage component when target is below 40% HP (execute scaling); canonical Kog ult finisher commits to last-hit on low-HP target (Phase 5.9.9, pattern B execute amp)
  Karma W block1 'Total Magic Damage' = 2× block0 per-tick (full Focused Resolve channel)
  Lulu Q block3 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (Glitterlance main 60-200 + 50% AP) + block 2 (slowed-target reduced 30-100 + 25% AP) — base 90-300 = 60 + 30; ap_pct=75% = 50% + 25%; both passes hit same target in canonical engagement
  Lillia W block1 'Increased Damage' = Watch Out! Eep! center hit — base 240-480 vs block 0 80-160 = exact 3× block 0; ap_pct=105% vs 35% = exact 3× scaling; canonical Lillia W engage commits to landing the center cone (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A center-hit amp)
  MissFortune E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full-Make-It-Rain-duration sum (per-tick × 8 ticks at rank 5: 23.75 × 8 = 190 base)
  Morgana W block3 'Maximum Total Damage' = full Tormented Shadow duration against rooted/CC'd target (block 1 'Maximum Damage Per Tick' × ~10 ticks; rank 5 base 75.6 × 10 = 756, ap_pct=229.5%); canonical Morgana Q-then-W burst commits both root and W full duration
  Morgana R block1 'Total Magic Damage' = both Soul Shackles damage ticks — base 400-700 vs block 0 200-350 = exact 2× block 0; ap_pct=140% vs 70% = exact 2×; canonical Morgana R commits to keeping shackles connected for full duration (initial damage + delayed-snap damage both land on same target) (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A multi-tick total)
  Nautilus E block2 'Maximum Total Damage' = Riptide 3-wave total on same target — base 110-390 vs block 0 55-195 = exact 2× block 0; ap_pct=100% vs 50% = exact 2×; canonical close-range Nautilus combo commits all 3 waves on the same target (block 1 is 'Reduced Damage' for subsequent waves on different targets — half of block 0 — but operator's commit is single-target which sums to 2×) (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A multi-wave total)
  Rell R block1 'Total Magic Damage' = full Magnet Storm 4-second channel (per-tick 15-35 + 13.75% AP × 8 ticks = 120-280 + 110% AP)
  Pantheon Q block1 'Increased Hurl Damage' = Comet Spear fully-charged hurl (hold Q for 1.5s before release) — base 155-455 vs block 0 70-190 = ~2.2× block 0; ap_pct=100% vs 50% = 2×; bAD=230% vs 115% = exact 2×; canonical Pantheon poke commits to full charge for max range + damage (Phase 5.9.9, pattern B fully-charged amp)
  Riven Q block1 'Total Physical Damage' = 3-cast Broken Wings total on same target — base 135-495 vs block 0 45-165 = exact 3× block 0; canonical Riven Q-Q-Q combo lands all 3 casts within 2.5s window on the same target (no per-cast AP/scaling difference between casts — all 3 inherit same scaling) (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A 3-cast total)
  Sett Q block1 'Total Bonus Physical Damage' = both empowered AAs landing on same target — base 20-100 vs block 0 10-50 = exact 2× block 0; Knuckle Down empowers next 2 AAs with bonus physical damage; canonical Sett close-range engage commits both empowered AAs to one target (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A 2-hit total)
  Skarner Q block1 'Total Bonus Physical Damage' = 3-hit Shattered Earth empowered Q chain — base 30-150 vs block 0 10-50 = exact 3× block 0; bAD=240% vs 80% = exact 3×; Skarner Q empowers 3 attacks with bonus damage; canonical empowered-Q rotation commits all 3 hits on the same target (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A 3-hit total)
  Soraka E block1 'Total Magic Damage' = Equinox immediate + delayed silence/damage — base 140-340 vs block 0 70-170 = exact 2× block 0; ap_pct=80% vs 40% = exact 2×; canonical Soraka E zone has initial damage tick + delayed proc on enemies still in zone after 1.5s, both land in standard commit (Phase 5.9.9, pattern A 2-tick total)
  Samira R block1 'Total Physical Damage' = full-Inferno-Trigger spray total (per-shot × 10 shots at rank 3: 25 × 10 = 250 base)
  Singed Q block1 'Total Magic Damage' = enemy stays in poison trail full duration (per-tick × 8 ticks at rank 5: 15 × 8 = 120 base, 10.625% × 8 = 85% AP)
  Sivir Q block2 'Total Maximum Champion Damage' = block 0 (Boomerang out 60-160 + 100% bAD + 60% AP) × 2 = 120-320 base + 200% bAD + 120% AP; canonical Sivir Q hits same target on out + return pass
  Syndra R block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' = burst at 7+ Dark Spheres stacked (typically achieved by level 11+ with Q/E charges); block 0 is per-sphere baseline, block 1 is min 3-sphere case, block 2 is max-stack burst-window
  Talon W block2 'Total Physical Damage' = block 0 (Rake throw 50-90 + 40% bAD) + block 1 (Rake return 60-180 + 90% bAD) — base 110-270 = 50 + 60 (rank 5 = 90 + 180); bAD=130% = 40% + 90%; canonical assassin W out-and-back through target
  Talon R block2 'Total Physical Damage' = 2× block 0 (Shadow Assault initial ring + unstealth re-engage hit); base 180-360 = 90×2 (rank 3 = 180 + 180); bAD=200% = 100% + 100%; canonical Talon R full burst commits to ult + re-engage
  Udyr R block1 (note: Udyr not in registry — kept channel default for now; may add if calibration shows under-counting)
  Varus Q block1 'Maximum Physical Damage' = fully-charged Piercing Arrow at 4-second wind-up; block 1 base 90-370 vs block 0 60-247 ≈ 1.5×; bonus_ad_pct=130-170% vs 87-113% ≈ 1.5×; canonical Varus opener commits to full charge in poke or engage
  Veigar R block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 2× block0 vs executed target (Primordial Burst at low HP)
  Velkoz R block1 'Maximum Damage' = full-Life-Form-Disintegration-Ray channel (per-tick × ~13 ticks at rank 3: 61.54 × 13 ≈ 800 base, 9.62% × 13 = 125% AP)
  Velkoz W block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block 0 (Void Rift initial hit 30-110 + 20% AP) + block 1 (detonation 45-165 + 25% AP) — base 75-275 = 30 + 45; ap_pct=45% = 20% + 25%; canonical Vel'Koz Researched-target proc fires on both halves
  Vex R block2 'Total Magic Damage' = block0 + block1 (Shadow Surge initial + mark detonation both land)
  Vladimir E block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 2-charge Tides of Blood; base 60-180 vs block 0 30-90 (2×); ap_pct=80% vs 35% (2.3×); caster_max_hp_pct=6% vs 1.5% (4×); canonical Vlad E spam to 2 charges before R burst combo
  Zoe Q block1 'Maximum Magic Damage' = long-distance Paddle Star post-E teleport; block 1 base 130-458 vs block 0 52-183 ≈ 2.5×; ap_pct=150% vs 60% (2.5×); canonical Zoe E-then-Q combo guarantees full-distance hit

Deliberately skipped:
  AurelionSol R — Empowered variant lives in form_index=1, not block_index; covered by future form_index override if needed
  AurelionSol Q — block2 'Total Maximum Magic Damage' is the no-early-release case which is rare in practice; block 0 default is realistic for short-charge case
  Caitlyn Q — block1 'Reduced Damage' is the FALLBACK case (units in line behind first hit), block0 IS the realistic burst case; no override needed
  Corki R — block 1 'Big One Physical Damage' is only every 4th missile (charge-based, not per-cast amped); requires conditional resource-state modeling to apply correctly
  Kennen R — block1 'Total Single-Target Damage' requires all 12 bolts hitting the same target which is rare; default per-tick more realistic
  DrMundo E — block0 is no-base stat-bonus, block1/2 require knowing current vs missing HP threshold; deferred (could benefit but ambiguous default)
  Renekton Q — block1 'Enhanced Damage' requires full Fury (50+); high but not universally assumable in burst window
  Renekton R — block1 'Total Magic Damage' is the 15-second passive splash total; too long-duration for burst-window assumption
  Aatrox W — block3 'Total Damage' requires chain landing then pull-back; CC-conditional
  Anivia R — channel ticks are ambiguous per-cast (block2 is amped but per-tick, not per-channel-total)
  Rumble R — block2 'Maximum Magic Damage' assumes full-duration channel which is realistic but Rumble R is also frequently zoned (1.5s of 4s commit); defer until calibration data
  Yone Q1/Q2/Q3 — Yone's three-stage Q chain has only one damage block per form (knockup is utility, not damage); block 0 for all three is correct
  Zed Q vs Q2-shadow — Zed Q has block0 (full) + block1 (reduced for non-first hits); the in-game model is single-target full damage for whichever Q lands first, so block 0 for both Q and Q2 is correct
  Leblanc Q vs Q2-mimic — Mimic-Q has its own damage formula not in Meraki's block schema; out of scope until Meraki ingests the mimic forms
  Gwen Q multi-snip / Aatrox Q chain / Akshan R bullets — complex multi-block forms with per-stage variants; defer per-champion modeling until each can be verified in isolation
  Xerath R — block 2 'Total Magic Damage' = all 4 bolts on same target; defer because Xerath R is commonly split-fire across multiple targets (Xerath is a long-range siege ult, not a single-target burst); operator can override per-call if focusing
  Galio W / Janna Q / Nunu W — fully-charged amps but each ability's tank/support role makes 'commits to full charge during burst' less universally true than the s195 picks; defer until calibration shows benefit
  Nidalee Q (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 1 'Maximum Magic Damage' represents max-distance Javelin Toss in human form (form 0), but s187's form_index registry already routes Nidalee Q to form 1 (Cougar Takedown). Form 1's block 1 is 'Cougar Takedown Total' which is a different mechanic entirely. Composing form_index=1 with block_index=1 would route through Takedown block 1, not human Javelin block 1. Defer until conditional form-specific block_index schema lift is ready (or operator can override per-call for human-form Nidalee scoring).
  Kassadin R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 2 'Maximum Bonus Damage' represents Riftwalk at max-stack count; exact 2× block 0 math is clean but Riftwalk stacks decay quickly and committing to 'max stack' is a resource-state condition (stack count), not a target-state or single-cast condition. Belongs in the carried-forward 'Conditional resource-state block_index' bucket alongside Corki R Big One, Renekton Q full Fury, and Aatrox Q chain stage.
  Aatrox W (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 3 'Total Damage' requires Infernal Chains landing the hit + pull-back trigger which is target-state CC condition; deferred to conditional schema lift.
  Akshan R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 3 'Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet' requires charging the full Comeuppance bullet stack; resource-state condition, deferred.
  Ambessa Q/W/E (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — all have 'Increased Physical Damage' blocks that are exact 2× block 0, but Ambessa's mechanics involve form swaps and recast variants (similar to Riven E spam stacks) — needs per-form analysis before committing to a registry entry.
  Pantheon W (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Shield Vault has only 1 damage block with no per-rank base scaling (passive-amped on-hit damage tied to attacks); not a candidate.
  Pantheon R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 1 'Magic Damage' (300-700) and block 2 'Reduced Damage' (150-350) — block 1 IS the canonical landing-spot full damage, but block 0 is missing/empty in the snapshot; default block_strategy='first' already picks block 1 here. No override needed (engine default behavior matches reality).
  Gangplank R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — has 5 'Total/Maximum' blocks tied to Upgrade choices (Death's Daughter / Fire at Will / Raise Morale); needs per-upgrade modeling (similar to Karma mantra / Khazix evolved), not a simple block_index pick.
  Jhin R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 1 'Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet' is 4th-shot scaling; the 4-shot ult is sequenced, fits combo_sequence modeling better than block_index since each shot has its own cooldown. Defer until conditional resource-state schema lift.
  Hwei R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 3 'Maximum Total Damage' requires full Spiraling Despair channel; covered by future channel-class follow-up if calibration shows benefit. The form 0 already produces reasonable per-cast damage at block 0; lift is +50% magnitude but operator can override per-call.
  Gwen R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Q1/Q2/Q3 chain has per-cast blocks; needs combo_sequence-style modeling (similar to Akali R / Riven Q) rather than single block_index, since each cast has independent timing and AP scaling. Defer.
  KSante R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 2 'Total Physical Damage' is All Out form damage; K'Sante R is a form swap (similar to Karma mantra / Aphelios weapon stances), needs form_index modeling not block_index. Defer until KSante form discovery in abilities snapshot.
  Karthus E (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Defile has only 1 damage block per-tick; channel-class follow-up if needed.
  Karthus R (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Requiem block 0 already represents full-channel global cast; no amp variant exists in snapshot. Engine default block 0 is correct.
  Mel Q (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — block 3 'Total Magic Damage' is multi-explosion total on same target (6× block 0); valid candidate but Mel's Q is a complex multi-stage spell with stack consumption — defer until Mel modeling is verified in burst combo_sequence registry.
  Naafiri Q (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — has 6 candidate blocks across pack-dog stack states; conditional resource-state bucket.
  Olaf Q (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Undertow returns to Olaf, block 3 'Total Monster Damage' is for jungle clear (operator picks up axe + recasts) not single-target burst; defer.
  Nasus E (Phase 5.9.9 skip) — Spirit Fire block 2 'Total Magic Damage' is full-duration zone (similar to Singed Q and Cassi W); valid candidate but Nasus is enchanter-class so dispatcher routes him to ds.dps for Q-stack scaling, not ds.ability. Add in future batch if mage/assassin overlap demands it.

Further expansion candidates remain (~200 multi-block forms across the roster). Operator can extend the registry per-champion as needed; default block_index=0 preserves pre-s191 behavior for any unmapped entry.
